findings.text: _DRAIN_STUCK_PHASES re-declares the waiting-request phases that reckon/crew/node.py:1529 (WAITING_REQUEST_PHASES) and reckon/crew/queue_edit.py:47 (WAITING_PHASES) already own, so the vocabulary now has four copies including the inline set at reckon/crew/runs.py:2153 in the same function; they already differ (launch-failed here, absent from both owners), so a phase added to one leaves the drain view's stuck rule silently stale.

`row["stage_seconds"] == LAST_LAUNCH_SECONDS` compares the drain view's output against the same constant the test wrote into the verdict record at :255, so it holds whatever duration is recorded and only proves the field is copied through; the assertion that does discriminate independently is :270's age bound derived from the pointer's own stamp.

`week["project"]["admissible_age_seconds"] == 720.0` compares against the literal the test itself put in the verdict record, so it guards the log-to-view wiring but cannot fail if the pass measured the wrong age — the independent half of that measurement lives in queue_admission's own tests, not here.
